summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the ordering of four new feeder containerships: two 2,800 teu high-reefer vessels at ~$46.5M each and two 1,800 teu vessels at ~$32.5M each, with options for up to four more. Deliveries are scheduled from June 2028 to January 2029. The orders expand the existing newbuilding program to ten vessels, financed with debt and equity. No special-situation M&A, activist, or restructuring event is disclosed; this is an ordinary capital-expenditure update.
